description: Verify that a Multicast Find (Unicast Flag = 0) → DUT replies with multicast OfferService (SOME/IP-SD §4.2.1)
approach:
[Objective]
A Find with the Unicast Flag cleared explicitly requests a multicast reply — DUT must obey regardless of cyclic timing.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT in Main Phase.
2. Tester → DUT (multicast): FindService with Unicast Flag = 0.
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: multicast OfferService.

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted offer is multicast.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_offer_not_multicast — offer not multicast
• Fail_no_offer_after_multicast_find — no offer at all

verdicts.Pass: DUT replied multicast to multicast Find — normal
verdicts.Fail_offer_not_multicast: Offer dst_ip not multicast after multicast Find
verdicts.Fail_no_offer_after_multicast_find: No offer within listen window after multicast Find
